No camping rate is published anywhere official (the city code leaves fees to council resolution); only Campendium's $15 from July 2021. Electric 30-amp, potable_water false and FCFS left derived (page silent). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: NO RATE: the city publishes no camping fee (city page silent; Code 47.06(4) 'The Council may establish by resolution such fees for camping facilities'). The only figure is Campendium's 'Last Nightly Rate $15' reported July 2021, too old and an aggregator, so fees stay empty. A call to City Hall 515-838-2311 would settle it.
COUNT: the city says 'nearly 60 camping stations'; the old note said ~30 electric sites. Count cleared rather than guessed; how many have electric is unstated.
WEAK: electric 30 and potable_water false rest on the old note only; the city page is silent. Campendium tags '20 Amp' while a reviewer writes '30 amp hookups around the city park'. Left as stored.
BOOKING: the city page's 'first-come, first-serve' line is about SHELTER reservations, not campsites; the stored camping FCFS stays derived.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed: an in-town block park, no water nearby on imagery.
